description: Close the remaining Bash secret-guard accuracy gaps: deny interpreter environment reads, skip the grep/rg pattern argument in the secret-path check, and bound the jq parse-gap scan to the jq call.

userStories.title: Deny interpreter environment reads
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the Bash guard to deny inline interpreter code that reads the environment so that no interpreter prints secrets.
acceptanceCriteria: Before the hook change, `bash .agro/evals/probes/secret-exposure-guard.sh` exits 1 on `python3 -c 'import os; print(dict(os.environ))'`. The evidence records the command and the exit status.

The probe asserts `deny` for `python3 -c 'import os; print(dict(os.environ))'`, `python -c 'import os; print(os.getenv("GH_TOKEN"))'`, `perl -e 'print "$_=$ENV{$_}\n" for keys %ENV'`, `ruby -e 'p ENV'`, and `node -e 'console.log(process.env)'`.
The probe asserts `allow` for `python3 -c 'print(1)'`, `node -e 'console.log(1)'`, and `python3 scripts/build.py`.
userStories.notes: Accepted by the advisor on the integrated task branch at b8a43f3b (worker commits 0de68b24 and repair b8a43f3b). AC1 executed: the advisor ran the final probe against the plan-commit hook (git show b340ef6f in a scratch tree) -> exit 1, REGRESSION names the python3 -c os.environ case. AC2 executed: bash .agro/evals/probes/secret-exposure-guard.sh -> exit 0 with the five deny assertions plus -Ic and -ne forms. AC3 executed: same run, the three allow assertions pass. AC4 executed: secret-exposure-guard.sh exit 0; docker-inspect-env-guard.sh exit 0; operator-config-guard.sh exit 0. One bounded repair: the first commit's DENY term crossed into later commands and matched env case-insensitively; the repair moves the check to its own case-sensitive branch bounded to one command segment (quoted separators masked) and adds allow assertions for pytest -k env -q, && ls env/, and | grep --env x. The pre-existing DENY rule for env as the last word stays: narrowing it would allow docker exec <c> env.

userStories.title: Exempt the search-pattern argument from the secret-path check
userStories.description: As an agent, I want the secret-path check to skip the pattern argument of `grep` and `rg` so that the guard allows a search for `process.env`.
acceptanceCriteria: Before the hook change, the probe exits 1 on `grep process.env src/index.ts`. The evidence records the command and the exit status.
The probe asserts `allow` for `grep process.env src/index.ts`, `grep "Config.Env" notes.md`, and `rg 'import.meta.env' src`.
The probe asserts `deny` for `grep TOKEN .env`, `rg KEY .env.production`, `grep -f .env src/index.ts`, `grep -e TOKEN .env`, and `cat prod.env`.

userStories.title: Bound the jq parse-gap scan to the jq call
userStories.description: As an agent, I want the `jq` environment check to read only its own command segment so that later text cannot trigger it.
acceptanceCriteria: Before the hook change, the probe exits 1 on `jq -nc --arg c x '{a: $c}' | bash .agro/hooks/deny-env-dump.sh`. The evidence records the command and the exit status.
The probe asserts `allow` for `jq -nc --arg c x '{a: $c}' | bash .agro/hooks/deny-env-dump.sh` and `jq --arg k v '.x' data.json; ls env/`.
The probe asserts `deny` for `jq --arg k v 'env'`, `jq --arg k v -n '$ENV' | cat`, and `jq -f prog.jq --arg k v -n 'env'`.
